teaserSummary: Out of ~349 vehicles listed on your site, we deep-scored 100 listing pages — and many are missing details AI assistants rely on to recommend a match.

teaserPains.label: AI READABILITY
teaserPains.body: AI readiness scored 20/100 — sampled unit pages have little or no JSON-LD / Product structured data, so assistants struggle to trust specs.

teaserPains.label: VIN
teaserPains.body: 100% of sampled listings are missing vin — a field AI assistants use to filter and recommend matches.

teaserPains.label: SEARCH MATCH
teaserPains.body: Query coverage scored 68/100 overall, but some shopper searches still fail — e.g. "Class A sleeps at least 8" — when required fields are blank.
